title: Stepping on the Sky
summary: Jin Wuxu tries to kill Wang Lin and is stopped, and the fifteenth drum strike brings a Heavenly Tribulation down on the Demon Spirit Land, felt as far as the Blood Ancestor at the East Sea entrance. Wang Lin turns his immortal power into demonic energy and survives the tribulation lightning by reverse cultivation, but a second punishment, Heaven's Wrath, locks onto his soul and the city is evacuated as the two Ancestors of Sky Demon Country come out of seclusion. A remnant soul of an Ancient Demon, trapped in the Demonic Battle Drum, saves him: it explains that the Gu clan, born with the Heavenly Dao, split into the Ancient Gods, Ancient Devils and Ancient Demons, and in return asks Wang Lin to gather its remnant souls from the treasures of the other eight countries. Gu Yunchi, grandson of the Second Ancestor, is told to bring Wang Lin to the Dragon Pool in three months. Wang Lin goes into seclusion in the immortal palace, where the Ancient Demon's Ascendant Crystal and the Ascendant method 'Understanding the Dao at Dawn' guide him, and after ten years his clone reaches Ascendant.

changes: Main source: AnimeKhor Indonesian fansub (ep121.id.srt) and its caption cards; the YouTube English track for this episode is machine-made and garbled, used only for cross-checks.
The Ancient Demon soul is listed as Bei Lou (贝罗), the name it is given in EP124/EP127; it is not named this episode.
flags: The person who once sacrificed himself to the Ancient Demon in the Dragon Pool to hide his own reverse cultivation (96s) is unnamed; likely Gu Yunchi.
The fansub writes 'Iblis Kuno' for both the Ancient Devils and the Ancient Demons in the Gu clan story (610-620s); split here as God / Devil / Demon.
Someone says the tribulation touches 'my Planet Tianyun' (135s); the speaker is not shown clearly.
The Second Ancestor calls 'Gu Yunpei' (927s); taken as a slip for Gu Yunchi, his grandson.
